name: scope-picker
title: Scope Picker
description: API-key scope picker that reads back in plain words what the key can do (destructive powers in red), flags write, delete and admin scopes, offers "Only what you've used" from real usage, and warns when the key never expires.

meta.stops: API key with admin powers leaks
meta.summary: Reads back what an API key will be able to do in plain words, flags risky scopes and suggests trimming to what was actually used.
meta.server: Grant only the scopes the server validates, enforce expiry server-side, and check scopes on every API call.
catches: Write, delete and admin scopes, called out
Scopes granted implicitly through implies chains
Scopes unused in the recent window, with a one-tap "Only what you've used"
Keys set to never expire, with a suggested expiry
limits: Only knows the scope definitions and usage you pass
Usage-based trimming can drop a scope needed by a rare job
Does not create the key; the server decides what it grants
a11y: Scope checkboxes use <label>s; scopes granted by a parent are marked
Expiry options are a radiogroup with an aria-label
Readback and warnings render in a polite live region; icons are aria-hidden
Highlight animation is skipped under reduced motion
